topic: Teacher Mapping (Class Teacher, Coordinator, Subject Teacher)
summary: This topic explains how to assign various roles to employees for a specific class, including Class Teacher, Coordinator, and Subject Teacher. It covers the rules for assigning single or multiple employees to these roles and their access implications.
steps: Navigate to the 'Subject Class Mapping' screen.
Select the specific class mapping you wish to edit.
To assign a 'Class Teacher': Select an employee from the 'Class Teacher' dropdown. Only one employee can be assigned as a Class Teacher per class.
To assign 'Coordinators': Select employees from the 'Coordinator' dropdown. Multiple employees can be assigned as Coordinators for a class.

To assign 'Subject Teachers': For each subject listed in the class mapping, select employees from the 'Subject Teacher' dropdown. Multiple employees can be assigned as Subject Teachers for a single subject.
business_rules: Only one Class Teacher can be mapped to a single class.
Multiple Coordinators can be mapped to a single class.
Multiple Subject Teachers can be mapped to a single subject within a class.
Class Teachers and Coordinators have access to all subjects of their assigned class.
Subject Teachers have access only to the specific subjects they are mapped to.
important_notes: Employee IDs are used for teacher assignments.
The 'Display Name' of a subject can be edited here, which will be visible to students and other users.
